meta.validity_rule: a null counts as evidence only if p01 <= observed lambda_1 <= p99, p01 and p99 from one np.percentile call on the null lambda_1 (the call that gives the rank p99s); percentiles reported as 100 (#{null < obs} + #{null == obs}/2) / n
meta.note_3pl: 3pl_post uses c = 0.25 for every score; for the >=k scores this floor is nominal (a uniform guesser is correct in >= k of 4 rotations with another probability)
meta.note_letter_post: letter_post (rotation-0 know-or-guess) exists only for rotation 0; the 4-rotation know-or-guess nulls kg_letter4 / kg_uniform4 apply to every score

meta.unparsed: conditional on the observed unparsed mask: every simulated dataset has the observed unparsed cells unparsed (scored wrong) and the other cells parsed. The choice likelihood conditions on the parsed status, so the fit is unchanged; rho_m (the per-model unparsed share) enters loglik_total only
meta.null_sampling: complete 4-rotation datasets from the fitted parameters (plug-in); per score, each observed kept column redrawn (whole question) until non-constant, at most 5000 redraw rounds (else the draw fails for that score; counted)

bootstrap_averaged_null.meta: each refit also gives exactly 10 successful draws on the OBSERVED kept columns (at most 100 attempts per score); refits short of 10 are excluded (counted), so every refit has equal weight

primary.rule: common tau: default start and 2 perturbed restarts, max |objective difference| 1e-09; log-likelihood gain over tau = 0: 616.9 for 1 parameter; PPC coverage of the per-model #correct-of-4 histogram 0.82 (tau = 0: 0.42); pre-set PPC rule passed: common tau False, tau = 0 False. Per-model tau_m: best perturbed restart minus the chosen fit -0.0 in the penalized objective; 2 of 5 starts reached max tau_m > 1e3.

meta.pipeline: simulate from the primary fit conditional on the observed unparsed mask; refit (default start, as the real data); the dataset's own kept columns and eigenvalues; N_CAL_NULL null draws from the refit (conditional on the mask and on those columns); percentiles of lambda_1..4
meta.bootstrap_averaged_null: each refit also gives exactly 10 successful draws on the OBSERVED kept columns (at most 100 attempts per score); refits short of 10 are excluded (counted), so every refit has equal weight

meta.what: datasets simulated from the fitted soft-preference model (ability + soft letter preference + option attractiveness + cell effect; no second factor; observed unparsed mask); the listed step-1 nulls refitted to each dataset; false-positive rates of the rank-matched p99 rule

meta.sets:
Parameter sets for the >=2 / 2PL check. refits: {name: (B, ...)} from the calibration bootstrap
    (data simulated from `hat`, refitted; both in the standardized gauge, theta mean 0 and SD 1).

      plug_in              : hat.
      boot_bias_corrected  : x_bc = 2 x_hat - mean_b x_b, elementwise, for a, b (non-gold), lambda and tau;
                             theta = theta_hat (its scale is fixed by the gauge).
      mean_square_rescaled : a, b, lambda each multiplied by sqrt(mean x_hat^2 / mean_b mean x_b^2) (the
                             refit inflation of the mean square, applied in reverse); tau * tau_hat / mean tau_b.
    Returns (sets, diagnostics).

meta.model_size: nominal parameter count (billions) from the model name/card
meta.replicate_B_note: B differs from A in the chosen option in 6 of 48000 cells (Qwen/Qwen2-7B-Instruct), in correctness in 5; it tests GPU nondeterminism only, not resampling
